    [Fact]
    public void EsFormat_Layout()
    {
        var s = default(EsFormat);
        AssertEqual(Abi(36, 32), EsFormat.SizeOf, "es_format_t sizeof");
        AssertEqual(36, Unsafe.SizeOf<EsFormat>(), "es_format_t Unsafe.SizeOf");
        AssertEqual(0, Offset(ref s, ref s.ICat), "es_format_t.i_cat offset");
        AssertEqual(4, Offset(ref s, ref s.IArray), "es_format_t.i_array offset");
        AssertEqual(16, Offset(ref s, ref s.Video), "es_format_t.video offset");
        AssertEqual(16, Offset(ref s, ref s.ICodecData), "es_format_t.i_codec_data offset");
        AssertEqual(Abi(32, 28), Offset(ref s, ref s.IBitrate), "es_format_t.i_bitrate offset");
    }

    public void ProbeBits_Layout()

        var s = default(ProbeBits);
        AssertEqual(8, ProbeBits.SizeOf, "probe_bits_t sizeof");
        AssertEqual(8, Unsafe.SizeOf<ProbeBits>(), "probe_bits_t Unsafe.SizeOf");
        AssertEqual(4, Offset(ref s, ref s.C), "probe_bits_t.c offset");
        {
            var b = default(ProbeBits);
            var ones = unchecked((uint)0x7);
            b.A = ones;
            AssertBits(ref b, 0, 3, "probe_bits_t.a");
            Assert.Equal(ones, b.A);
        }
        {
            var b = default(ProbeBits);
            var ones = unchecked((uint)0x1F);
            b.B = ones;
            AssertBits(ref b, 3, 5, "probe_bits_t.b");
            Assert.Equal(ones, b.B);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ProbeZoo_Layout()
    {
        var s = default(ProbeZoo);
        AssertEqual(16, ProbeZoo.SizeOf, "probe_zoo_t sizeof");
        AssertEqual(16, Unsafe.SizeOf<ProbeZoo>(), "probe_zoo_t Unsafe.SizeOf");
        AssertEqual(12, Offset(ref s, ref s.ITail), "probe_zoo_t.i_tail offset");
        {
            var b = default(ProbeZoo);
            var ones = true;
            b.FBool = ones;
            AssertBits(ref b, 0, 1, "probe_zoo_t.f_bool");
            Assert.Equal(ones, b.FBool);
        }
        {
            var b = default(ProbeZoo);
            var ones = unchecked((ProbeColor)(-1));
            b.FEnum = ones;
            AssertBits(ref b, 1, 3, "probe_zoo_t.f_enum");
            Assert.Equal(ones, b.FEnum);
        }
        {
            var b = default(ProbeZoo);
            var ones = (int)(-1);
            b.FSigned = ones;
            AssertBits(ref b, 4, 5, "probe_zoo_t.f_signed");
            Assert.Equal(ones, b.FSigned);
        }
        {
            var b = default(ProbeZoo);
            var ones = unchecked((ushort)0x7F);
            b.FUshort = ones;
            AssertBits(ref b, 9, 7, "probe_zoo_t.f_ushort");
            Assert.Equal(ones, b.FUshort);
        }
        {
            var b = default(ProbeZoo);
            var ones = unchecked((byte)0xFF);
            b.FByte = ones;
            AssertBits(ref b, 16, 8, "probe_zoo_t.f_byte");
            Assert.Equal(ones, b.FByte);
        }
        {
            var b = default(ProbeZoo);
            var ones = unchecked((ulong)0xFFFFFFFFFFUL);
            b.FWide = ones;
            AssertBits(ref b, 24, 40, "probe_zoo_t.f_wide");
            Assert.Equal(ones, b.FWide);
        }
        {
            var b = default(ProbeZoo);
            var ones = (sbyte)(-1);
            b.FSbyte = ones;
            AssertBits(ref b, 64, 4, "probe_zoo_t.f_sbyte");
            Assert.Equal(ones, b.FSbyte);
        }
        {
            var b = default(ProbeZoo);
            var ones = unchecked((byte)0xF);
            b.FChar = ones;
            AssertBits(ref b, 68, 4, "probe_zoo_t.f_char");
            Assert.Equal(ones, b.FChar);
        }

    public void VideoFormatTDovi_Layout()
    {

        AssertEqual(8, Unsafe.SizeOf<VideoFormatTDovi>(), "video_format_t::dovi Unsafe.SizeOf");
        AssertEqual(0, Offset(ref s, ref s.VersionMajor), "video_format_t::dovi.version_major offset");

        {

            var b = default(VideoFormatTDovi);

    // Windows value, then SysV value, for the ABI the tests run on.
    private static int Abi(int w, int s) => OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? w : s;

    private static nint Offset<TOwner, TField>(ref TOwner owner, ref TField field)
        => Unsafe.ByteOffset(ref Unsafe.As<TOwner, byte>(ref owner), ref Unsafe.As<TField, byte>(ref field));

    private static void AssertEqual(long expected, long actual, string what)
    {
        if (expected != actual)
            Assert.Fail($"{what}: expected {expected}, actual {actual}");
    }

    // Exactly the bits [bitOffset, bitOffset + bitWidth) of the zeroed struct may be set.
    private static void AssertBits<T>(ref T value, long bitOffset, int bitWidth, string what)
    {
        var bytes = new ReadOnlySpan<byte>(Unsafe.AsPointer(ref value), Unsafe.SizeOf<T>());
        for (var bit = 0; bit < bytes.Length * 8; bit++)
        {
            var expected = bit >= bitOffset && bit < bitOffset + bitWidth;
            var actual = ((bytes[bit / 8] >> (bit % 8)) & 1) != 0;
            if (expected != actual)
                Assert.Fail($"{what}: bit {bit} is {(actual ? "set" : "clear")}, expected the field to occupy bits {bitOffset}..{bitOffset + bitWidth - 1}");
        }
    }
